environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in us-east-1. The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the instance via nginx reverse proxy. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering layer. SQLite database contains production user records including emails and internal role assignments.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
config.proxy: nginx reverse_proxy to localhost:8080, no modsecurity
